narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the codebase.
finalText:
**1291 hits across 94 files. Most are safe.**

| Area | Hits | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `services/`, `lib/audit.js` | 1203 | Rename freely |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Applied history, never edit |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Generated, refresh overwrites edits |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Frozen public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js` wire value | 1 | Frozen public field name |

250 SQL strings name the DB column. Those stay.

In [serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) flip the left key only. Miss it and `account_id` drops from every response.

Next: ask them for a column-rename migration plan.
